title: Millsaps Heating & Plumbing
purpose: Standing instructions for account A2, the happy path.
facts: Account A2: 25 vehicles, home shop east; contacts from accounts.json (Tina Ragsdale dispatcher, Hal Millsaps president, Joyce Millsaps office manager).
Standing slot Monday 7:30, five vans (ledger acct.A2.weekly_slot); unit numbers sent by Friday noon; priority on Monday mornings; a holiday Monday moves the slot to Tuesday.
Vans back by 15:30 unless the dispatcher was called by noon.
Drivers up to 300 USD like every account; the dispatcher up to 1,000 USD a vehicle; the president above.
Company rate; paper statement mailed with invoices attached.
Voice: slot 16, first person, warm and exact, signed.

list_items.item: The drivers drop the vans and leave. A driver may approve up to $300 like any account's driver, but they would rather not: call Tina.
Tina Ragsdale approves up to $1,000 a vehicle: (423) 555-0121.
Over $1,000, Hal Millsaps himself: (423) 555-0163. He answers.

list_items.section: Things I know about these vans
list_items.item: Units are M-101 to M-125 and the number is on the rear door.

list_items.section: Things I know about these vans
list_items.item: The Express vans eat front brakes. Measure the pads at every visit and tell Tina a visit ahead, so it is never a surprise.

list_items.section: Things I know about these vans
list_items.item: The ladder racks sit lower than our door at bay 2. Bay 1 or bay 4.

new_facts: A holiday Monday moves the slot to Tuesday; back by 15:30; bay 1 or bay 4 because of the ladder racks (colour, no data footprint).
